title: Welding.
officialText:
The details of design, workmanship and technique for welding, inspection of welding and qualification of
welding operators shall conform to the requirements of the specifications listed in Sections 2205, 2206, 2207, 2209 and 2210.
Special inspection of welding shall be provided where required by Section 1704.
